theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Myth: Mutual Funds Are Only for the Rich
body: False. You can start investing with minimal amounts. Regular contributions, however small, build wealth over time through disciplined investing.
caption: Mutual funds democratize investing by allowing everyone to participate in market growth regardless of income level. Consistency matters more than the initial amount. #MutualFundMyths #InvestmentForAll #SmartInvesting #WealthBuilding #DemystifyingMF
